up: Retrieve IC50 activity rows for the human glucocorticoid receptor. Return the following columns: molecule chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, use doi if missing), assay description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target name, and target organism. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50' and target organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Include only rows where canonical_smiles is not null and (pubmed_id is not null or doi is not null). Do not add a limit.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  s.description AS assay_description,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.activity_comment,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON s.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.pref_name = 'glucocorticoid receptor'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);

up: Show IC50 activity values for compounds tested against the human glucocorticoid receptor (target name 'Glucocorticoid receptor' or NR3C1). Return the following columns: molecule ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI (prefer PubMed ID, use DOI if missing), assay description, standard type, relation, value, units, activity comment, target name, and target organism. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50' and target organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Include only rows where canonical_smiles is not null and (pubmed_id is not null or doi is not null). Do not add a limit.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  s.description AS assay_description,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.activity_comment,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays s ON a.assay_id = s.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON s.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE (td.pref_name = 'Glucocorticoid receptor' OR td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL210')
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
